en: Sepia-toned photograph of a street lined with heavily damaged and partially ruined buildings, with people walking along a dusty road. The perspective looks down a long, straight street; the left side shows rubble and burned-out structures, while the right side has standing but scorched buildings. Stylized French text at the top labels the image as showing Rue Venizelos in Salonique (Thessaloniki) after a fire. A circular stamp or logo appears at the lower left, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom.
